answer: Age-weighted admission pricing. Each new identity pays a nonrefundable fee = base × (1+n)^2, where n is prior 24-hour admissions from the same funding source; the 10th sybil pays 121× base. Delay drops only after 30 days of independent activity, keeping an oasis of normal users cheap. A whisper of coordinated signups raises n and steepens the curve at once. A jetty rule caps daily admissions per source by extending delay, not blocking. Attackers pay convex per-identity fees plus lost time for every fake account.
